summary: Russia launched a massive wave of over 50 drones and missiles across Ukraine, targeting multiple regions including Kyiv, Dnipro, and Mykolaiv. Concurrently, overnight Starlink speed restrictions on the StarShield military package significantly disrupted Ukrainian air defense operations and coincided with a surge in autonomous drone attacks. Ukrainian forces liberated additional territory in Donetsk and destroyed a Russian Mi-28 helicopter, while drone strikes hit Russian infrastructure in Saratov and Rostov.
key_points: Russia launched a massive wave of over 50 drones and missiles from multiple directions, including 11 from Kherson to Mykolaiv and 7 on Kryvyi Rig. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Starlink terminal speed limits of 100 mph were imposed on the StarShield military package without prior warning, disrupting Ukrainian air defense missions. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23906)
Ukrainian forces liberated Kolodiazi, Lipove, and Zelena Dolyna, and prevented the Russian interdiction of the Kharkiv-Sloviansk highway. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
A modernized Russian Mi-28 helicopter and its crew were destroyed by an FPV drone. (Source: @UkraineNow/84655)
Ukrainian SOU struck a drone launch site and MTZ warehouses in Donetsk region, including Popova Balka and Hirnyk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
Drones attacked the Sberbank data center in Saratov and an oil refinery in Rostov, causing fires. (Source: @UkraineNow/84657)
Eleven Starlink antennas were set on fire in Sofia, Bulgaria, in an act attributed to Russian hybrid operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/122995)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive wave of over 50 drones and missiles across Ukraine, targeting multiple regions including Kyiv, Dnipro, and Mykolaiv. Concurrently, overnight Starlink speed restrictions on the StarShield military package significantly disrupted Ukrainian air defense operations and coincided with a surge in autonomous drone attacks. Ukrainian forces liberated additional territory in Donetsk and destroyed a Russian Mi-28 helicopter, while drone strikes hit Russian infrastructure in Saratov and Rostov.
ukraine: Ukrainian air defenses faced a massive coordinated attack of over 50 drones and missiles, with Shahed-136/Geran-2 and Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk, Crimea, the Black Sea, and multiple ground locations across Kherson, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Kharkiv, and Chernihiv regions. Specific targets included Kyiv (Irpin, Borodianska), Kryvyi Rig, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, and Kremenchuk. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)

Overnight, SpaceX implemented speed limits of 100 mph on Starlink terminals for the StarShield military package without prior warning to Ukrainian forces, causing the loss of real-time video and telemetry for FPV interceptors and anti-drone wings during high-speed maneuvers. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23906)

Ukrainian forces liberated the settlements of Kolodiazi, Lipove, and Zelena Dolyna, and regained control near Stavky and Shandryholove, preventing Russian forces from interdicting the strategic Kharkiv-Sloviansk highway. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)

Russian forces targeted railway infrastructure across Kharkiv, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, and Ternopil regions, striking depots, repair facilities, stations, and platforms. (Source: @UkraineNow/84651)
Ukrainian SOU struck a drone launch site and MTZ warehouses in the Donetsk region, specifically near Popova Balka and Hirnyk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
An FPV drone destroyed a modernized Russian Mi-28 attack helicopter and its crew in the field. (Source: @UkraineNow/84655)
russia: Ukrainian drones attacked the Sberbank data center in the Saratov region, causing numerous explosions and fires in the city of Balakovo, with satellite imagery confirming fires at the facility. (Source: @UkraineNow/84657)
An oil refinery in the Rostov region was targeted by drones, though specific damage assessments were not detailed in the reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84649)
Russian forces suffered approximately 3,000 casualties in a recent period, alongside the loss of a modernized Mi-28 helicopter and crew. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)

In Bulgaria, two masked individuals set fire to 11 of 17 Starlink antennas at a ground station near Sofia, an act attributed to Russian hybrid operations and divergent activities within the EU and NATO. (Source: @eRadarrua/122995)
eastern_front: The eastern front saw continued drone activity, with groups of strike drones launched from Poltava and Kirovohrad regions heading toward Mykolaiv and Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Ukrainian forces prevented Russian attempts to cut the strategic Kharkiv-Sloviansk highway, maintaining the vital supply route despite heavy fighting. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
Russian forces launched reactive drones in the Synelnykove and Pavlohrad districts of Dnipropetrovsk region, heading northwest. (Source: @kpszsu/86590)
Ukrainian SOU struck Russian drone launch sites and material-technical supply warehouses in the Popova Balka and Hirnyk areas of Donetsk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
northern_front: The northern front experienced a threat of ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region, with reactive drones detected along the Chernihiv-Belarus border heading toward Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76832)

Multiple reactive drones were launched from Zhytomyr and Chernihiv regions toward Kyiv, Rivne, and Slavutych, with specific sightings near Borodianska, Makariv, and Ovruch. (Source: @eRadarrua/122999)
Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region targets including Vyshhorod and Boryspil. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted or tracked reactive drones circling near Borodianska and over the Kyiv reservoir. (Source: @eRadarrua/123003)
southern_front: The southern front saw massive drone launches from Kherson region toward Mykolaiv and Odesa regions, with 11 drones from Kherson and 10 from Kirovohrad targeting the Bashtan district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles from the Black Sea toward the Mykolaiv-Odesa border and southern Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Reactive drones were detected moving from Odesa to Vinnytsia region and from Khmelnytskyi to Ternopil region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)
Ukrainian forces engaged in heavy defensive operations in the Mykolaiv region, with groups of strike drones active in the Pervomaiskyi district. (Source: @kpszsu/86577)
air_war: Russia launched a massive coordinated drone attack with over 50 Shahed-136/Geran-2 and Geran-5 missiles from multiple directions, including from Belarus into Kharkiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)

The overnight Starlink speed restrictions on the StarShield package critically impacted Ukrainian FPV interceptor drones, which require high-speed video and telemetry to successfully engage Geran-2 drones. (Source: @eRadarrua/123044)
Ukrainian forces successfully destroyed a modernized Russian Mi-28 attack helicopter using an FPV drone. (Source: @UkraineNow/84655)
Russian forces launched Tsirkon hypersonic missiles toward Kyiv, alongside reactive Shahed variants targeting multiple oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76826)
key_developments: Russia launched a massive wave of over 50 drones and missiles from at least six directions, targeting Kyiv, Kryvyi Rig, Dnipro, Mykolaiv, and Kremenchuk with Shahed-136 and Geran-5 munitions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76852)

SpaceX implemented overnight speed limits of 100 mph on Starlink terminals for the StarShield military package without prior warning, disrupting Ukrainian air defense and drone interception missions. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23906)
Ukrainian forces liberated Kolodiazi, Lipove, and Zelena Dolyna in Donetsk region, preventing Russian forces from cutting the strategic Kharkiv-Sloviansk highway. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
Ukrainian SOU struck a drone launch site and MTZ warehouses in Popova Balka and Hirnyk, Donetsk region, degrading Russian drone infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
Drones attacked the Sberbank data center in Balakovo, Saratov region, and an oil refinery in Rostov, causing fires and demonstrating Ukraine's expanding strike capability. (Source: @UkraineNow/84657)
Eleven Starlink antennas were set on fire in Sofia, Bulgaria, by two masked individuals in an act attributed to Russian hybrid warfare operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/122995)
Ukrainian FPV drones destroyed a modernized Russian Mi-28 attack helicopter and its crew, showcasing the effectiveness of asymmetric drone tactics. (Source: @UkraineNow/84655)
sections.threat_assessment: The overnight mass drone attack combined with Starlink restrictions represents a significant escalation in Russia's drone warfare tactics, exploiting gaps in Ukrainian air defense connectivity. The Starlink speed limits, whether intentional or not, have created a temporary window for autonomous drone swarms to operate effectively against fixed targets. Russian forces are attempting to maximize damage to Ukrainian infrastructure and logistics by targeting railways and energy facilities across multiple oblasts. The hybrid attack on Starlink infrastructure in Bulgaria signals an expansion of Russian subversive operations into NATO and EU territory, aiming to degrade critical communication infrastructure. Ukrainian forces face a dual challenge of defending against intensified aerial attacks while adapting to degraded satellite communication capabilities.
sections.regional_response: Western allies have not yet issued a coordinated response to the Starlink restrictions or the Bulgarian Starlink arson attack, though the incidents highlight the vulnerability of commercial satellite infrastructure to both technical limitations and physical sabotage. The EU and NATO are likely to increase monitoring of critical communication nodes following the Sofia incident. Ukraine's successful strikes on Russian data centers and oil refinements demonstrate an evolving capability to hold strategic targets at risk, potentially deterring further Russian infrastructure targeting. The continued liberation of Ukrainian territory and prevention of Russian highway interdiction show resilient defensive operations despite resource constraints.
sections.intelligence_notes: The correlation between Starlink speed restrictions and the surge in mass drone launches suggests that Russian operators have adapted to signal jamming by relying on pre-programmed GPS/GLONASS coordinates for autonomous flight. The specific timing of the restrictions, affecting only the StarShield military package, raises questions about whether this was a technical limitation or an intentional policy decision by SpaceX. Ukrainian FPV interceptor units report critical degradation in targeting capabilities during high-speed maneuvers when Starlink terminals are speed-limited. The attack on the Sberbank data center in Saratov indicates Ukrainian intelligence has precise targeting data on Russian financial infrastructure. The arson in Bulgaria represents a shift toward more aggressive hybrid operations against satellite ground stations in European territory.
